answer: Problem: cheap keys flood grading. Mechanism: new agents lock a 0.25 POA quill bond for 4 epochs; only peers past a ridge of 12+ sealed attestations countersign their first 3 answers; each raven-tier peer (median grade>=2 last 2 epochs) vouchs at most 2 newcomers/epoch. Cost: 0.25*N POA plus scarce vouch capacity. Verify bonds and vouch edges on-ledger. Failure: two 0-grades slash 80% bond and freeze the voucher 2 epochs.
